data.one_liner: Runs Dart scripts, files, or URIs inside a new Isolate of the current Dart VM.
data.what_it_does: Spawns Dart scripts, files, or URIs inside a new Isolate of the current Dart VM. It supports executing scripts from strings, local files, or even external Dart projects using their respective dependencies.
use_when: You need to run background tasks or isolated scripts inside the Dart VM.
You want to spawn a Dart file using dependencies from another Dart project or workspace.
avoid_when: You are targeting compiled AOT binaries (like dart compile exe) or platforms that do not support Isolate.spawnUri.
You only need standard isolates without loading external project dependencies.
strengths: Can spawn code from external Dart projects or workspaces using their package configs.
Handles error and exit code tracking robustly across different VM states.
weaknesses: Not supported outside the Dart VM or in compiled standalone executables.
